entry_points.text: Writer exits by clearing current pointer, unwinding expedition nesting, tearing down lazy work, freeing arrays and marking stopping; fake writer exercises random primitives with stutter; timer callback only frees its structure.

Reader loops single reads with pauses, stutter, online and boot waits, optional tick timer and cross-calls, cleaning timer on exit; timer and handler entries each do one read with private state and optional queueing exercise.
Up-down worker scans slots, warns once on overdue, launches down operations, sleeps with stutter, then cleans up; toggle worker loops random offload toggles with fuzzed interval sleep.
Stall init creates the thread only when stall is requested; notifier callback logs invocation as handled via a static block.
Stats thread loops interval sleep, print and shutdown absorption until stop; forward handlers derive containers and either requeue or terminate, or enqueue with accounting.

exports.text: Expedited grace control nests: one operation increments a shared counter to request expedition, the other decrements to release.
CPU callback offload mode changes through one toggle; helpers request offload or deoffload for a CPU and return status.
Grace torture helpers set grace-thread wait only when enabled and positive, report momentary quiescence with idle warning, and clear or delegate deferred quiescence.
Stall notifier registration warns and delegates only when enabled else fails; unregistration always delegates.

hazards.text: After a real stutter with no nodelay, slow grace or stop past a deadline, writer scans for empty free lists on non-current objects, then freezes tracing, optionally debugs, warns and dumps.

One-time diagnostics flag protection misuse, completed polls, deep pipes, lingering boost, unpaired completions and late timers; deactivation serializes parking, publication and waiting to avoid races.
Re-offload warns on online or non-empty queues; stall registration always warns; stats alert on memory, barrier, boost, deep-pipe and writer-stagnation conditions with dumps.

invariants.text: Normal and full polls keep older observations, resample while awaiting the new poll, replace first complete match with warning if none, and sleep between probes; after each wait version bumps, expedition nesting cycles with checks, lazy work optionally queues, then stutter runs.

Barrier checks skip timer context, delegate by installing checked and checker indices with acquire checks and relaxed compare-exchange, and the checker validates loop progress with acquire ready, failure counting, poisoning, and release cleanup.

Handler context flag plus interrupt state gate extension changes and validation; checks compare recorded and observed IRQ, BH, preempt, sched and RCU state with non-preemptible and RT adjustments, share common diagnostics, and candidate masks derive from global and operation bits with nesting, context and fallback rules.

Extension needs active protection and appends random intervals except up-down marker reserved for down path; polling is rare and helper-gated with sequence-bounded histograms and deep-overlap trace; segment dumps detail intervals and flags; fresh state is cleared and up-down slots get random state and disarmed timers unless disabled or failed.
Deactivation expects offline targets, empty queues after barrier, atomic toggle publication under grace lock, and wait for mark clear; only re-offload with boot state and thread is accepted.

Forward completions bucket by elapsed time with clamping, count and sequence recording; reporting trims empty tail and logs deltas; freeing unlinks under lock then frees outside with rescheduling and quiescence; yielding prefers eager scheduling when tickless and preemptible.
Boost creation is idempotent with priority raises and failure counting; stall episodes combine holdoff, grace wait, and locked busy loops with IRQ or preemption control then restore.

Stats aggregate pipe, batch, wrap and up-down counts with pointer and health logging; memdump self-tests address kinds; module logging reports tunables; forward globals hold mutex, array, sequence, max count and stop flag.

locks.text: Transitions acquire new coverage before releasing old through BH, RCU-BH, IRQ, preempt, sched-RCU, then inner and outer RCU locks, logging under combined coverage, then release in reverse with index repacking.

Offload orders CPU-set exclusion, global mutex, then short grace or callback sections with IRQ masking; callback lock is taken only when offloaded; predicates test the mark under nocb lock with IRQs saved.
Forward enqueue and accounting hold forwarder spinlock with IRQs saved and advance tail with release ordering; boost pointer and throttle changes hold a dedicated mutex with stop after unlock.

state_machines.text: Writer cycles normal, expedited, full and expedited-full conditional and polled waits plus direct sync, announcing states, sleeping, waiting, then advancing reuse pipe; unknown modes warn once.

Single reads move through preparation, protected access with early exit, optional reshaping, then validation with histogram, polling check, release and error history; up-down slots cycle idle, armed and completing with timer validation, with init and cleanup handling vectors and orphans.

Toggle moves CPU records between offloaded and direct, ignoring redundant and rejecting online requests; re-offload validates, announces, switches mode, waits and unparks; deactivation drains, parks, verifies, and delegates or clears directly.
Forward callback requeues via current operations when stop is clear, else records terminal value and returns.
Stall thread normalizes repeats, optionally registers, runs episodes with IRQ disable only first, logs, unregisters, absorbs shutdown and parks until stop.

structs.text: Verification, single-read and up-down records hold loop and grace markers, element identity, protection encodings, bounded segments with cursor, plus timer, ordered in-use flag, CPU, counters and random state; a global pointer holds the vector.

Forwarder state, node, histogram entry and instance form a locked queue with counts, timestamps, sequences and identifier; thresholds fix duration, per-callback and total minimums, buckets per second and derived length.
Protection encodings, bounds, capacities, conversions and offload markers govern extension and storage; values live in owning definitions.
